name: hos-tracker
description: HOS Tracker — Truck Hours of Service

scripts.build: cp index.html www/index.html && cp dashboard.html www/dashboard.html && cp manifest.json www/manifest.json && cp icon.png www/icon.png && cp logo.png www/logo.png && cp dash.png www/dash.png && cp trasparente.ico www/trasparente.ico && cp icon-192.png www/icon-192.png && cp icon-512.png www/icon-512.png && cp apple-touch-icon.png www/apple-touch-icon.png && cp icon-32.png www/icon-32.png && cp icon-96.png www/icon-96.png && cp icon-144.png www/icon-144.png && cp sw.js www/sw.js && cp hardware-permissions.js www/hardware-permissions.js && (npx cap add ios 2>/dev/null || true) && npx cap sync && node scripts/patch-ios-permissions.js
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync

author: lloammes81
